scope: 10 new test files for 11 API routes (coverage-backfill wave)

findings.summary: session.test.ts: Set-Cookie deletion assertion is too weak — only checks cookie name is present, never asserts Max-Age=0 or equivalent; real deletion not verified
findings.remediation: Add: expect(setCookie).toMatch(/Max-Age=0/i) and expect(setCookie).toMatch(/Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970/i) OR verify the set-cookie value is the empty/expired form

findings.summary: audit.test.ts: GET /api/audit happy path never tested — no 200 response exercised for either inquiryId or sessionId branch; only error paths (401/400/403) are covered
findings.remediation: Add test: seed an event via logAuditEvent, then GET ?sessionId=OWN_SESSION_ID and expect 200 with events array. Also add: GET ?inquiryId=... with own-session event → 200

findings.summary: audit.test.ts: POST /api/audit no-auth path is untested — requireSession returning 401 is never exercised on POST; only CSRF and valid-body paths are covered
findings.remediation: Add test: mockRequireSession returning NextResponse 401, call POST, expect 401

findings.summary: canal.test.ts: Suez 200 happy path is not tested — only the missing vessel_nt error (400) is covered; the successful quoteCanal('suez', ...) code path is dark
findings.remediation: Add test: GET /api/canal/suez?vessel_dwt=50000&vessel_type=tanker&vessel_nt=30000 → expect 200 with at least one numeric field

findings.summary: canal.test.ts: Non-finite vessel_dwt (e.g. 'abc', 'NaN', 'Infinity') is not tested — route rejects via parsePositiveFinite but Class 2 boundary is absent
findings.remediation: Add test: vessel_dwt=abc → expect 400 with error matching /finite positive/i

findings.summary: port-da.test.ts: Zero vessel_dwt is not tested — route checks vesselDwt <= 0 and returns 400, but this boundary (Class 3: negative/zero) is uncovered
findings.remediation: Add test: vessel_dwt=0 → expect 400 with error matching /positive integer/i

findings.summary: port-da.test.ts: Float vessel_dwt (e.g. '12345.5') is not tested — route rejects non-integers via Number.isInteger check but Class 2 boundary is absent
findings.remediation: Add test: vessel_dwt=12345.5 → expect 400 with error matching /positive integer/i

findings.summary: economics.test.ts: In-process cache (15-min TTL) is never tested — same request twice should not call computeEconomics a second time, but no cache-hit assertion exists
findings.remediation: Add test: call POST twice with same body in same module scope, assert computeEconomics mock was called exactly once

findings.summary: economics.test.ts: Missing route.toPort is not separately tested — only fromPort-missing is exercised; symmetric branch is dark
findings.remediation: Add test: body with fromPort present but toPort missing → expect 400

findings.summary: health-root.test.ts: version hardcoded to '0.1.0' in dedicated test — brittle assertion breaks on any version bump without signalling a real regression
findings.remediation: Replace with: expect(typeof json.version).toBe('string') and expect(json.version.length).toBeGreaterThan(0), or import VERSION from the route

rework_applied: HIGH-1 + HIGH-2 fixed in commit 1bc392e. HIGH-1: session.test.ts now asserts Expires=epoch cookie deletion. HIGH-2: audit.test.ts now tests GET 200 with seeded event + POST no-auth 401. MEDIUM: canal NaN boundary + suez happy path added; port-da zero/float DWT added.
